copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 装上后，claude-mem 会在 Cursor 里跑起来：本地 worker 与钩子随插件自带，MCP 服务 claude-mem-local 与之通信，记录和取用记忆。也可改为连远端服务器。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上安装配置 claude-mem 时触发，包括选本地 worker、远端 worker、本地 host 登录观察者，或走 cmem.ai 远端推理。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 里安装 claude-mem 的本地 worker
把 claude-mem 换成远端 worker，服务器地址填我的主机
观察者改成用本地 host 登录，provider 设为 host

howto.what_en: After install, claude-mem runs on Cursor: the plugin ships the local worker and hooks, and the MCP server claude-mem-local talks to it to store and fetch memory. A remote worker can be used instead.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai inference.

say_en.text: Install the local claude-mem worker in Cursor for me
Switch claude-mem to a remote worker with my server URL
Set the observer to local host-login with provider host
say_en.note: Uses the loopback shim on port 37778
